title: Estimating storage per year

kcs.statement: Storage per year = new records per day × bytes per record × 365, plus media stored separately, multiplied by the replication factor if replicas are counted.
The retention period sets total storage: a 5-year retention needs about 5 times the yearly figure, so stating retention is part of the estimate.
